name: Daisy Chain
source:
Scientist Benjamin Holloway has, in body and mind, created a perfect duplicate of himself. His double looks like him, talks like him, and acts like him. But is he the same?

[From [url=https://air-gong.itch.io/daisy-chain]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
科学家本杰明·霍洛威在身体和精神上创造了一个完美的自己复制品。他的替身看起来像他，说话像他，做事也像他。但他是一样的吗？

[来自[url=https://air-gong.itch.io/daisy-chain]Itch.io[/url]]
